brief.audience: Operations coordinators and teammates in teams of 5–30 people

Two unequal but related solid forms are the proposed visual interpretation of the supplied handoff direction.

brand_strategy.positioning: A scheduling and shift-coordination service for operations coordinators and teammates in teams of 5–30 people.
brand_strategy.audience_need: Recognize a dependable shared place for arranging availability and handing work to the next person, even in a 32px sidebar.
brand_strategy.brand_promise: Coordination that feels steady and accommodating; this is an intended identity, not a claim of proven product performance.
brand_strategy.distinctive_principle: Two offset substantial forms share one open joining interval. Soft corners and an uneven length rhythm make the handoff feel flexible while preserving a clear small silhouette; no literal wave or loop.
brand_strategy.typography: No lettering, initials, digits or slogan. The two shapes alone carry the identity, including in the sidebar.
brand_strategy.color_roles: Deep blue-violet #364A9F leads in the upper-left form; supporting blue #6591C4 fills the lower-right form. Pure white #FFFFFF is the open joining interval and the entire opaque exterior.

swatches.role: primary upper-left solid form; the darker, visually leading half
supporting lower-right solid form; clear blue companion with a different lightness
opaque pure-white exterior canvas in every corner and margin, plus the open central joining interval

notes: Foreground colors chosen by the assistant under the user's delegation; no locked foreground, reference extraction or provider call.
Pure-white background is the user's explicit requirement. No quantitative contrast or output-color claim is made before generation.

palettes.rationale: The darker first form anchors the coordination gesture; the lighter second form gives the handoff two readable parts without relying on a literal scheduling pictogram. White preserves the required clean surface and joining interval.
